sinopsis.es: Biopic del boxeador argentino José María Gatica, 'el Mono', estrella del pugilismo de los años 40 y 50, desde su infancia hasta su trágico final.
sinopsis.en: A biopic of Argentine boxer José María Gatica, 'el Mono', a pugilism star of the 1940s and 50s, from his childhood to his tragic end.
